top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Gain After Nvidia Shakeup, Oil Steady: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks edged higher as investors weighed the fallout from Nvidia Corp.’s leadership upheaval on the broader artificial-intelligence trade. Oil and Treasury yields held their gains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Gold Holds Drop to Near One-Year Low as Rate-Hike Bets Increase
top_signals.summary: Gold traded near a one-year low as investors ramped up bets on the Federal Reserve hiking rates to combat persistent inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Jensen Is Not the Only Executive To Have a Relationship With a Spy: Nell Minow
top_signals.summary: Nell Minow, Chair at ValueEdge Advisors, says she was surprised that Nvidia lacked an independent board chair and a formal succession plan. She discusses the allegations regarding Jensen Huang in an interview with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
